Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment
For 3116 N Western Ave
From RS-3 to RT-4

1. The applicant seeks a zoning change from RS-3 to RT-4 in order to meet the bulk and density
standards to construct a new 3-story 2 dwelling unit residential building with 2 garage parking
spaces and 2 bicycle parking spaces.
